notes.title: V1.03 Patchnotes - Survival Update
notes.notes:
- Added Survival Mode. Score decreases over time, when it reaches 0, game over.
- Added outline to minimap that scales with your view to assist in finding unfinished cells on your screen.
- Added some optimization to the "flood opening" of '0' cells process to reduce memory usage.
- Added default sleep timer setting to automatically start a sleep timer in infinite modes.
- Added a reminder of the chunk goal number when playing Blitz Mode to pause menu.
- Added a check on load to ensure all stat based achievements are unlocked correctly.
- Added some color changing UI to show when numbers are changed. ie Opening a mine flashes score to red to show penalty.

- Fixed exploded mine count in worlds was not saving. First load of a world should correctly count existing mines.
